messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Cobalt Health beta cohort onboarding next Tue/Wed. Enrollment list shows 6/10 completed. Need help pushing invites and final intake call. :wave:

Jared (Solutions): I can run the enablement call Tue 10am PT. Is 45 min enough? :calendar:

Maya (CS): 45m + 15m Q&A should be fine. Need deck + 1-pager. Ravi — can you prep the deck?

Ravi (Enablement): Yep, will spin a focused 20-slide deck + runbook. Can I get product callouts?

Jared (Solutions): Add the 'fallback model' notes and sample prompts. I'll paste snippets in thread after this.

Sam (Onboarding): I've got 4 pending invite acceptances — sending a second nudge today with scheduling links. Link: https://cal.com/redwood/cobalt-onboard

Maya (CS): Also let's push the feedback survey immediately after the session — keep it 6 Qs. CS Ops: can we wire automated post-session survey? @CS Bot

CS Bot: scheduled_survey_event: Survey template 'beta_short_v2' queued to send 30m after session.

Ravi (Enablement): Drafted slide with prompt examples. Paste:
```
System: You're an assistant for medical triage.
User: Patient data...
```

Maya (CS): Great. One more risk note — Cobalt has a 60-day renewal trigger. If low usage in first 30 days, flag as risk. Please log adoption signals to the 'renewal-watchlist' sheet.

Jared (Solutions): I'll add analytics dashboard tiles: DAU, avg latency, top prompt types. Will share after lunch. :clock1:

Sam (Onboarding): FYI — sent 2 nudges, 1 accepted. Updated roster in our onboarding doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/boards/C-139

Maya (CS): Thanks team. Action items: Jared deck snippets + dashboard, Ravi deck and runbook, Sam follow invites, CS Bot survey. Quick sync tomorrow 9am PT to verify readiness. :thumbsup:
